questions.question: In Berkeley Lab's Queued Up data, how many MW of solar-only requests were active in PJM's queue at the end of 2025?
questions.answer: In the Berkeley Lab Queued Up data, PJM's solar-only queue held 54,121.7 MW of active requests, across 638 requests (interconnection_queue_summary, entity queue:pjm:solar, variable total_active_mw). The warehouse stores this as a single yearly row labelled 1 January 2025 (UTC). It is the stock of active solar-only requests in the latest Queued Up file, which the warehouse retrieved in October 2026. It is not a figure dated exactly 31 December 2025. A separate variable, mw_active, gives 11,571.1 MW in the 2025 row (interconnection_queue_summary). The table appears to break that variable out by the year each request entered the queue, so I did not use it for the end-of-2025 figure. The table is derived by the ERW from Berkeley Lab and GridTracker's Queued Up file (CC BY 4.0).

questions.question: What after-tax internal rate of return do utility-scale solar projects in Texas earn in 2026?
questions.answer: Not in the warehouse. It holds no after-tax internal rate of return for utility-scale solar in Texas. It has no project-finance or return data for solar. Its only return-type figures are battery assumptions in battery_sourced_ranges, and those are not for solar. The nearest solar data is energy-only merchant revenue in merchant_revenue_monthly, and that is not an IRR.
